content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab LTD (UK) to GitLab France S.A.S., how does the automatic life‑insurance coverage threshold differ between the two entities?","answer":"In the UK, the automatic cover threshold is 4× base salary, while in France the policy requires a scheme/contract number to access the beneficiary portal, implying no automatic 4× salary threshold is mentioned.","evidence_a":"The automatic cover threshold for the Group Life Insurance policy is 4x base salary.","evidence_b":"Use the [scheme/contract number] to access your account"}
